item.title: NBC news helicopter crashes and kills at least 3 in LA neighborhood
item.description: A local NBC news helicopter crashed in a Los Angeles neighborhood on Tuesday, killing at least three people while reporters were covering the nearby crash of an SUV and a city bus, officials said.

item.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
item.description: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.

item.title: Turkish habit of stashing gold "under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
item.description: For years, Turks have stashed their gold at home against a raining day, mistrustful of banks. Now the government says that tradition hurts the economy

item.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
item.description: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

item.description: A new global democracy report finds the U.S. at its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years it has been measured.

item.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
item.description: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

item.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
item.description: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.
